summary: Sales Orders module fully tested - backend + frontend. 15/15 backend pytest cases passed covering: order number format/increment (YYMM + letter + 6 digits), all forward-only status transitions (saved->picked, saved->shipped, picked->shipped, shipped->returned), all backward/invalid transitions blocked with detail invalid_transition, bad_status returns 400, ship/return stock math (-N on shipped, +N on returned), edit lock after shipped/returned (locked_after_shipped), chart shape (15 months YYYY-MM, 4 series of 15 ints each), list filter+search+sort (date desc default, order_number asc, field1/field2 alpha), settings labels persistence with 12-char truncation. Frontend mobile flow verified end-to-end: login, Orders tab toggle (tab-purchase/tab-sales) keeps Purchase content unchanged and reveals so-create-btn / so-orders-btn under Sales; Settings 'Orders' card with so-label1/so-label2/so-labels-save saves Customer/PO Ref labels and they propagate to the create form labels and the sort chip labels; create form (/sales-order/new) shows so-field1/so-field2/so-shipref/so-comment/so-date/so-today plus ship-from warehouse chips (so-wh-*); so-add-product opens picker with so-pick-* options; so-save navigates to /sales-orders where chart, status tabs (so-tab-*), so-search, sort chips (so-sort-date/order_number/field1/field2) and so-row-* are all present; detail page shows order number + 4 status checkboxes (so-status-saved/picked/shipped/returned) and so-delete; advancing saved->picked via web confirm dialog succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1537 lines; consider splitting sales-orders endpoints into a dedicated module for maintainability (non-blocking).
Order-number letter rollover at 1M only ever returns A in normal usage; acceptable but worth noting as edge case.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_ sales orders/products under warehouse@test.com (PRO) and a fresh isolated user (TEST_iso_*) to verify the A000001 reset. Test data is auto-prefixed TEST_ and does not modify seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sales_orders.py is idempotent and can be re-run. Browser flow uses page.on('dialog', accept) for the web window.confirm() popup that advances status. Custom labels were set to 'Customer' / 'PO Ref' on the primary user; if reset is needed run PUT /api/settings with the desired labels. Current system month observed in tests = 2026-06 (YYMM=2606); the task description's '2601A000001' was just an example of the format - the actual prefix matches whatever the current month is when run.
